title: Bound entry-shadow replay for owned descents
body:
**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Test one saved chart-3 entry aggregate plus an exact destination-chart entry bank as a substitute for an owned descent to rank one on the exact #7334 native word. The largest individual price uses role 1503 at clock 39811. Replacing its rank-five descent with one rank-one lift has optimistic gross about 67.502591 raw across 17 invocations. The relaxed whole eight-case upper is below 289 raw.

Independent forward and reverse replays agree on every coefficient across all 1,501 inputs for the eight exact rows. Every row has 52 nonzero exterior coordinates outside the two allowed entry charts. For role 1503, the chart-3 ancestor at role 146 also fails. No case advanced and no tested key remains unresolved. Other historical bank snapshots or a separately priced multi-chart route require separate tests.

From a clean POSIX checkout run python3.12 -I -B research/p104-entry-shadow-owned-descent-bound/replay.py. It verifies pinned source, both exact replays, pricing, and input corruption controls. Registered, read-only Git-free export and all 27 onboarding checks passed locally. This branch includes two #7257 CI prerequisites.

#7334 and #7113 supply the comparator and signed caller. #7387, #7389 and #7409 give related first-contact, visibility and donor evidence. #7362 and #7298 supply the directed rank price. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
